clause: SVG Filter + Rasterize + Document Raster-Effect Settings + Apply Last Effect [STU-FX-030,STU-FX-009]

scope.summary: Implement the SVG/rasterize raster-effect coordination: SVG Filter (apply/import XML-defined SVG filter effects, editable as XML for .svg round-trip per 14.13, adapter-neutral native evaluation where primitives map), Rasterize/live (live raster appearance: resolution/background/anti-aliasing without destroying vector source), Document Raster-Effect Settings (doc-level StudioEffectStack policy: resolution/color-model/background/anti-aliasing applied by every raster effect on vector art), Apply Last Effect (re-applies most recent effect with same or new settings, the [STU-FX-009] repeat surface across R/V/T/G).

expected_tests: test: SVG filter apply/import + XML round-trip (.svg); Rasterize preserves vector source; doc raster-effect settings applied by every raster-on-vector effect; Apply Last Effect re-applies
acceptance_criteria_original: SVG Filter (apply/import + XML round-trip), Rasterize (live), Document Raster-Effect Settings, Apply Last Effect

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-FX-030] The document raster-effect resolution/color-model/background/anti-aliasing settings are a document-level `StudioEffectStack` policy applied by every raster effect used on vector art. SVG-filter effects are an XML-defined interchange path (import/apply/edit) preserved for `.svg` round-trip (14.13) and are adapter-neutral (native evaluation where the filter primitives map to native passes). | Studio effect | Targets | GPU | Behavior (normative) | |---|---|---|---| | SVG Filter (apply/import) | V,T,G | Opt | Applies XML-defined SVG filter effects and imports filters from SVG files; editable as XML for round-trip. | | Rasterize (live) | V,T,G | Opt | Live raster appearance (resolution, background, anti-aliasing) without destroying the vector source. | | Document Raster-Effect Settings | doc | No | Global resolution, color model, background, anti-aliasing applied by every raster effect in the document. | | Apply Last Effect | R,V,T,G | n/a | Re-applies the most recent effect with same or new settings ([STU-FX-009]). | --- ### 15. Figma-Origin Composite Effects

[STU-FX-009] A "repeat last effect" affordance re-applies the most recent `StudioLiveFilter` kind + parameters to the current selection as a new stack entry; a "repeat with new settings" variant opens the parameter surface first. This is one deduped command, not two menu items.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
